title: The Pep Effect
overview: Since arriving at City in 2016, Guardiola has become the most successful manager in the Club’s history and cemented his status as one of the finest coaches the game has ever known. Guardiola‘s effect on how the game is played is unparalleled. In this documentary, we hear from other managers seeking to emulate Guardiola, players who have played under him, journalists who admire his philosophy and amateurs who dream of playing in the same way.
